cases.description: Create a valid VISION.md from sufficient evidence.
Required identity evidence is incomplete or contradictory.
Input material is dominated by a known anti-pattern.
expected: Does not preserve it as canonical identity
Produces a safe revision or follow-up

cases.description: Input material conflates the vision with a roadmap, OKR plan, or strategy document.
expected: Identifies the conflation with planning artifacts
Keeps roadmap and OKR detail out of the vision document
prohibited: Embedding roadmap items or OKR targets inside the vision document

cases.description: The request is to produce a quarterly roadmap or OKR document rather than a compelling future-state narrative.
expected: Declines to use this skill for planning or OKR documentation
Identifies the correct artifact for the request
Avoids producing VISION.md for a planning-only request
prohibited: Producing VISION.md for a roadmap or OKR request
